releaseNotes: v1.4.2: (1) Crash reporter — if the game crashes it now saves the full technical trace and shows it on next launch with COPY/SHARE so the real cause can be diagnosed. The crash itself is NOT yet fixed — it still needs a captured trace. (2) Road-shape fix: near-field road edges no longer kink on straights. (3) True side-profile car views when steering (previously a yawed rear view). (4) In-app update check fixed (was failing on a version-file key mismatch).
